intro: The excavators broke the seal on a tomb that appears on no dynasty list, its entrance hidden behind a false wall of limestone that had withstood the attentions of tomb robbers for millennia. Every chamber they cleared was empty but for a single inscription, carved in a script that is not quite hieroglyphic, its signs shifting shape when the lamplight moved across them. The head scribe was a creature of habit, pressing his personal seal at the head of every record before setting quill to papyrus. Dust lay thick on the flagstones, and the air tasted of old incense and the dry rubs of linen wrappings. Somewhere in the dark, a sealed door that an early survey had missed clicked shut behind them, and the torches guttered as if the tomb itself had drawn a breath.
echo: The title meant only 'great house', but the house was the king.

puzzles.title: Curse Of The Tomb
puzzles.flavor: Fences and corners; some have an animal inside.

meta.title: Meta: Valley Of The Kings
